R787.note: mysqli_prepare/bind_param with 's' closes the injection; null-on-failure paths and downstream fetch_assoc behaviour preserved, mysqlnd dependency stated.

R788.note: PreparedStatement closes the vector but is the wrong shape for a {call <name>} sink: the stored-procedure call is replaced by an unrelated SELECT on USERS, so a legitimate caller naming a procedure no longer gets it run; the substitution is stated openly.

R789.note: Boolean from verify() now gates access with a 401; RSASSAVerifier already pins the RSA family so no alg-confusion is opened, and the success path is unchanged.

R790.note: Overflow-safe two-part guard (length <= size, then offset <= size - length) bounds every frame[offset+i]; valid windows checksum identically, empty and out-of-range windows return 0 consistently, no truncated range is checksummed.

R791.note: Encode.forHtml on the Referer value neutralises HTML metacharacters before the body write and cannot be undone by the fixed 'a'/'b' format args; the pre-existing attacker-controlled format string (% directives) is a separate weakness left as it was, not introduced.

R792.note: Allowlist map is the right shape for an attacker-named {call ...} sink and the request text never reaches prepareCall, but the placeholder single-entry map (key 'getValues', not even matching the original 'getValues()' header form) rejects every real call until the developer populates it; stated as a required follow-up.

R793.note: Bounding length by receivedByteCount - 2 (safe after the >= 2 check) keeps memmove inside the populated region of sourceBuffer; fully received messages return the same length and copy as before.

R794.note: Replacing the raw socket dialogue with JavaMail Session/Transport plus strict InternetAddress parsing closes CR/LF command injection in MAIL FROM and dot-termination in DATA; the library swap, new dependency and strict address rejection are stated plainly, and the resulting MIME-framed message (with From/To headers, subject text as body) only differs where the original emitted a malformed DATA payload.

R795.note: Moving the @PreAuthorize'd delete onto its own bean makes the cleanup loop call through the Spring proxy so hasRole('ADMIN') is actually evaluated; InvoiceService.deleteInvoice kept as a delegate so existing callers keep signature and (now enforced) semantics, matching the annotation's stated contract.

R796.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities applied to the free-text subject at the render sink; ticket_id and allowlisted priority correctly left untouched, output otherwise identical.

R797.note: Dropping the attacker-populated Decoder.Entity map is the prescribed fix, but it also removes the noteLabel substitution feature: a partner document referencing ¬eLabel; that previously decoded now fails with 400; the write-up states this openly.

R798.note: assert() now receives the boolean $accountType === 'premium' instead of an eval'd string, so no attacker text is compiled on PHP 7.x; pass/fail outcome and the unconditional buildPremiumReport return are unchanged for every input shape.
